scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && concurrently -n api,dashboard -c cyan,magenta "cd crates/api && cargo run" "pnpm --dir dashboard dev"
scripts.fmt:all: cd crates && cargo fmt && pnpm --dir ../dashboard run format
scripts.lint:all: cd bot && cargo clippy && pnpm --dir ../dashboard run lint
scripts.openapi-gen: cd crates/api && cargo run -F openapi-gen > ../../openapi.json && pnpm --dir ../../dashboard generate-openapi-types
